Select compounds with IC50 measurements in nM against human Isocitrate dehydrogenase [NADP] cytoplasmic. Join molecule_dictionary to compound_records, docs, activities, assays, and target_dictionary. Join compound_structures to obtain canonical_smiles. Filter by target name 'Isocitrate dehydrogenase [NADP] cytoplasmic' and organism 'Homo sapiens', and by standard_type 'IC50' and standard_units 'nM'. Return compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, and target_organism. Keep all activity rows; do not deduplicate. Sort by compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, and target_organism.
